title: UCP manifest
question: Does the store publish a Universal Commerce Protocol manifest?
method: GET /.well-known/ucp. Pass on valid JSON with a version and a capabilities array. The spec version the manifest declares is recorded in the evidence.

title: UCP capabilities declared
question: Which UCP capabilities does the store claim?
method: Pass when the manifest declares at least checkout; the evidence lists cart, catalog, order, identity linking and payment handlers.

title: ACP checkout endpoint advertised
question: Does the store advertise an Agentic Commerce Protocol checkout?
method: Look for an OpenAPI document or discovery link pointing at checkout_sessions. Pass when HEAD or OPTIONS on the endpoint is reachable without creating a session.

title: ACP feed policy fields
question: Does the feed carry the seller and return fields an ACP merchant needs?
method: When an ACP or OpenAI-style feed is found, pass when seller_name, seller_url, return_policy and return_window are present on sampled items. Skip when no such feed exists.

title: Payment-handler signals
question: Does the checkout page expose agent-friendly payment handlers?
method: Detect Google Pay, Apple Pay, Stripe Link or PayPal scripts or markers in the checkout page HTML. Pass when at least one is present.

title: AP2 or x402 signals
question: Does the store signal support for agent payment protocols?
method: Informational. GET /.well-known/x402 and look for HTTP 402 payment-required headers on a probe. Pass when any signal is present.

title: Guest checkout and cart API
question: Can an agent build a cart without an account?
method: GET /wp-json/wc/store/v1/cart must respond 200 with a cart object. Warn when the checkout page requires login (guest checkout disabled).
